_what: Read-only boot census for the LoadFirst (option B) unattended launches: logs the saved enable order as the kit sees it at file scope and again at the pregame menu, the running ModsLoaded order, the pack's LoadFirst/VacuumWalks/HubLocalAccess statuses, then quits at the menu. No save is loaded, nothing is written.
mustNotBeListedWhy: The autorun would start a colony and race the menu read; forced-inactive changes the statuses this leg reads; the set payload rewrites the order this leg is meant to read back.
